items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Well I think Mituai was, as far as tone, you know. He played more on the style of a soloist, you know. He was a nice triple-tongued man and everything, you know.

ctx.x: Who would you say had the best tone around, if any of the guys? Best tone? Yeah.
Well I think Mituai was, as far as tone, you know. He played more on the style of a soloist, you know. He was a nice triple-tongued man and everything, you know.
Who taught you to play trumpet, Peter?
